title: Fractured Cosmic Portrait
description: A surreal portrait of a dark-skinned man with glasses and a beard, positioned centrally. His figure is intersected by a white grid of rotating diamond-shaped panels filled with vibrant colors, while a large ammonite fossil and swirling cosmic nebulae in deep blues, purples, and fiery oranges occupy the background.
prompt: Surreal portrait of a thoughtful Black man with round glasses and a beard, centered in frame, his face and torso intersected by a white diamond grid of colorful rotating squares. A large detailed ammonite shell spirals in the foreground. Background features swirling cosmic nebulae, stars, and smoke in deep indigo, purple, fiery orange and yellow tones, dramatic lighting, painterly digital art style
